id_status: PROPOSED: next unassigned number after SG-000130; final id is part of founder decision FD-UP-4
title: Unified platform contracts v1, audit hash chain and licence gates (inert)

dependency_notes.SG-000093: Closed. Its AuthorityMode, ExecutorClass and ExecutionState vocabularies move to orcel-contracts with identical serde spellings and are re-exported from orcel-policy; lease issuance and checking stay in orcel-policy.

objective: Give every later unified-platform grain one set of versioned wire contracts in crates/orcel-contracts (principal and device, per-OS identity binding, lease view and grant reference, session, tool registry entry, capability discovery with explicit unsupported, the job state machine reusing not_started|dispatched|completed|cancelled|outcome_unknown, the audit event, the sidecar IPC handshake, heartbeat and kill, and eight additive failure codes), a SHA-256 hash chain in orcel-audit with an `orcel audit verify` command, and CI gates for per-crate and per-package licences and for the kernel dependency direction. Nothing becomes reachable by any client.

include: WP1-00: activation of this grain and of the other Wave 1 drafts the founder approves; Firecrawl status correction in DONOR_REGISTRY.md and donor_registry.json.

WP1-01: root deny.toml (licences, bans, sources); scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs over every package-lock.json under apps/, packages/ and tests/; a cargo metadata test enforcing the dependency direction of section 3.2; a text scan refusing AGPL markers under crates/ outside the FD-06 files already listed in docs/orcel/notices/.

WP1-02: section 4 contract types with golden JSON fixtures, generated JSON Schema files under docs/orcel/contracts/schema/, canonical_json, and the new FailureCode variants LEASE_REQUIRED, LEASE_INVALID, LEASE_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM, UNSUPPORTED, POLICY_BLOCKED, JOB_NOT_FOUND, QUEUE_FULL and RATE_LIMITED.
WP1-03: hash-chained audit events, rotation continuity, orceld recording request, decision, approval, dispatch, state, lease and emergency_stop events, and `orcel audit verify`.
exclude: Any new MCP tool, REST route, executor, dependency in crates/*, listener, network path or authority.
Any change to lease issuance, lease checking, approvals or Safe-mode policy.
macOS and Linux identity readers (Wave 2, WP2-01).

authority_delta.contracts: None. Wire types only; no issuance, no checking, no secret material.
authority_delta.audit: None. Adds integrity evidence to existing events without widening what is recorded; redaction rules unchanged.

decisions.question: Activate this grain and its id

invariants: orcel-contracts depends only on serde and serde_json and contains no platform-specific code.
Every existing wire spelling, including FailureCode values and the orcel-full-control-lease/1 schema, is unchanged.
Inbound authority-bearing contract objects refuse unknown fields.
LeaseView is a projection and is never accepted as proof of authority.
Audit events never contain a raw SID, token handle, credential, secret or page content.
No kernel crate depends on an app, test, package or third_party unit.
acceptance: Every new contract type round-trips its golden fixture; unknown fields are refused where required; schema drift fails CI.
orcel-policy's existing tests pass unchanged after the vocabulary move.
Editing, deleting or reordering one audit line is reported at that line by `orcel audit verify`; rotation keeps continuity.
Root cargo deny and the npm licence check pass on current main; a fixture crate with an AGPL dependency fails them.
The dependency-direction test fails for a fixture edge from a kernel crate to an app.
tests: cargo deny check licenses bans sources

review.alibaba_open_code_review: delegation mode per standing founder decision (2026-10-10) with manual review of excluded files
review.security_review: fresh-context security judge on WP1-03; d1-local advisory only

successor_requirements.SG-000102: Uses the job state machine and audit chain.
successor_requirements.SG-000132: Uses LeaseRef and DispatchAuthority in every Full Control audit event.

done_when: WP1-00 to WP1-03 are merged with exact-head qualification and the canonical record names this grain CLOSED.
